documents.privacy: Versioned localized policy; final approved document required
documents.terms: Versioned localized terms; final approved document required

actions.not_now: Exit onboarding to WIN-002, discard unsaved consent draft, do not record acceptance or delete Firebase account
actions.read_document: Shared scrollable document reader; return preserves current choices
actions.continue_to: WIN-008 if required; otherwise next profile milestone WIN-009 or account creation WIN-004 for pre-auth entry; unfinished destination gets explicit checkpoint

storage.authority: Authenticated server validates versions and required decisions; client cannot forge a completed onboarding status
storage.retry: Idempotent receipt; no duplicate acceptances; failure keeps screen and allows retry

separation: Privacy acknowledgement is not blanket consent to health-data processing
Terms acceptance is not optional analytics or marketing consent
Google sign-in is not health-data consent
No ranking or social visibility is enabled here
Any needed health-data consent is separate and precedes collection
release_gate: Final truthful policies, operator/contact and retention/deletion process must be supplied and reviewed before public release. No invented legal text or placeholder URLs presented as real documents.
